name: documents
description: Enterprise document processing: convert between PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, MD, TXT using LibreOffice + python-pptx + python-docx + openpyxl + weasyprint. Supports editing, generating, and converting documents with precision.

arguments.name: action
arguments.description: convert, generate, edit, inspect, merge, split, extract_text

arguments.name: input_path
arguments.description: Input file path relative to work dir

arguments.name: output_path
arguments.description: Output file path (optional, auto-generated if missing)

arguments.name: output_format
arguments.description: Target format: pdf, docx, pptx, xlsx, html, md, txt, csv, odt, odp

arguments.name: data
arguments.description: Tabular data for XLSX generation {rows: [[...]], columns: [...]}

arguments.name: slides
arguments.description: Array of slide objects {title, content, bullets} for PPTX generation

arguments.name: replacements
arguments.description: Dict of {old_text: new_text} for edit action

arguments.name: files
arguments.description: Array of file paths for merge action

output.description: Operation result with file path, size, pages, metadata
